steps.message:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-12, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1228.3 | 0.41 | 0.41
2 | 678.3 | 0.50 | 0.91
3 | 2104.5 | 0.76 | 1.67
4 | 3417.4 | 29.87 | 31.54
5 | 3516.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as HAA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-12, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-12 (Area T)**

The interpreted vertical electrical sounding (VES) profile comprises a 5-layer geoelectric model:
* **Layer 1:** 0.41 m thick, 1228.3 Ω·m (base at 0.41 m)
* **Layer 2:** 0.50 m thick, 678.3 Ω·m (base at 0.91 m)
* **Layer 3:** 0.76 m thick, 2104.5 Ω·m (base at 1.67 m)
* **Layer 4:** 29.87 m thick, 3417.4 Ω·m (base at 31.54 m)
* **Layer 5:** Basement extension, 3516.3 Ω·m

The resistivity progression follows:
* Layers 1–3: $r_1 > r_2 < r_3$ (**H**)
* Layers 2–4: $r_2 < r_3 < r_4$ (**A**)
* Layers 3–5: $r_3 < r_4 < r_5$ (**A**)

The calculated sequence yields an **HAA-type** curve, consistent with the classification on file.
